transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-03-18
Start: 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Jordan Lee, Alyssa Kim, Marcus Patel, Priya Rao, Evan Stone

Summary (auto): Quick sync to validate launch readiness; incident RCA follow-up; finalize canary and telemetry.

00:00 Jordan: okay thanks everyone for joining, we'll kick off, trying to keep to an hour, uh we left off with the incident RCA items, marcus can you start with the infra follow-up?
00:18 Marcus: yeah sure, so the 3-10 event was basically a KV cache degradation under a combination of large prefix churn and an unlucky GC pause, the cache eviction policy didn't trigger fast enough — so the tail latency spiked. we pushed a hotfix to change the eviction threshold and disabled an aggressive background compaction which seemed to help.
00:45 Priya: small note, our logs show a spike in connection resets too, maybe the compaction caused brief resource starvation on the host. not sure if that's the same as the gc pause.
01:02 Evan: i've been running the reproducer on staging, i can get latency patterns to mirror prod when i hammer with the same prefix distribution; creating a synthetic workload with more short-lived contexts reproduces it pretty reliably.
01:25 Jordan: okay good. what's the recommended permanent fix vs mitigations for launch?
01:30 Marcus: long term we should add a smarter eviction policy that is workload-aware and a KV cache sharding tweak, short-term we bump eviction aggressiveness and add an emergency fallback to bypass cache for >95th pct requests.
01:50 Alyssa: from a product perspective, we need a clear SLO and rollback plan customers can rely on. also need to catalog which customers are on dedicated vs hosted for targeted communications.
02:05 Priya: runbook item — if cache tail latency > 200ms for 3m, trigger partial rollback to previous variant and increase instance count; also notify on-call and product. i've added the alert in staging but need a review before prod.
02:30 Jordan: alright let's talk canary strategy — evan?
02:34 Evan: propose a progressive canary: 1% traffic for 2hrs, 5% for 6hrs with automated health checks (latency, error rate, cost per token); if any metric crosses threshold for >5 minutes, auto rollback. thresholds: p95 latency +20% over baseline, error rate >0.5% absolute.
02:58 Marcus: also include a cost anomaly check; we had a burst from retry storms in last test.
03:05 Alyssa: and product owners want a manual pause button in console, not just auto rollback, so they can hold and investigate without flipping back.
03:15 Priya: doc that as 'manual mitigation' step in runbook.
03:20 Jordan: telemetry — what dashboards are missing?
03:23 Evan: missing end-to-end token-level cost breakdown in the canary dashboard and a per-route latency heatmap; i'll add a per-model breakdown and add traces to link sample requests to traces.
03:45 Marcus: we should run a full scale test that includes synthetic prefix churn and KV cache pressure to verify. propose 50k concurrent sessions for 30m on staging.
04:00 Alyssa: timeline — we want sign-off next week to stay on schedule for early april dev preview. any blockers?
04:10 Priya: security/compliance sign-off is pending a quick check of audit log retention. i reached out to security but no blockers expected.
04:20 Jordan: okay assign owners then. marcus to run scale test, priya update runbook, evan finalize canary config, alyssa draft comms, i'll compile sign-off.

04:40 Marcus: quick note re: deployment infra — our autoscaler had a hiccup in last smoke where a node group didn't spin up fast enough, we need a warm pool configured for GPU nodes to avoid cold-start latency.
04:58 Priya: agree — add warm pool and validate startup times; also ensure KMS key access is pre-warmed for private deployment tests.
05:15 Alyssa: also need to verify documentation for dedicated customers, especially around V P C peering and KMS setup steps. security asked for sample terraform snippets.
05:35 Jordan: i'll coordinate with solutions to get snippets.
05:45 Evan: one more thing — the perf benchmarks spreadsheet we shared, there are a couple of models where quantization changes the accuracy noticeably; product needs to approve which models are acceptable to run quantized in launch.
06:05 Alyssa: we'll take quantization sign-off as part of model gating; ops should tag quantized vs full-precision in the rollout.
06:20 Marcus: timeline check again — if we run scale test 3/24 and fix any issues by 3/23-3/25 range, we can get final sign-off 3/25 and start canary 3/26.
06:40 Jordan: sounds doable. any other items?
06:45 Priya: action item to add retention and audit log checklist for compliance.
06:50 Alyssa: i'll reach out to legal for the release checklist for enterprise customers.
06:58 Jordan: perfect, recap and next steps — we'll record action items in this doc and meet briefly next tuesday to verify pre-launch test results. thanks everyone.
07:10 (crosstalk) Marcus: thanks. Priya: thanks all.
